notes: sigma(4,4) = 171 = 4^4-4^3-4^2-4-1 (sigma4_4 in NT/E11.2/E11_2_lrat.lean; sigma4 n = least N such that every n-colouring of [1,N] has a monochromatic x+y+z=w). Lower bound: explicit 4-colouring of [1,170] checked by decide. Upper bound: kernel-checked LRAT (CaDiCaL 2.1.3, trimmed, 187 512 RUP additions, 4.26M hints, 5342 s kernel time over 30 modules) for the symmetry-broken CNF restricted to its unsat core (44 526 genuine solution clauses, each checked valid in Lean); the encoding lemma proves the symmetry breaking sound for any list of valid solution tuples. LRAT data (35 MB) not in git; regeneration steps in NT/E11.2/lrat/README.md. Outside Lean: none.
